text:
simon: Heads-up — starting a quick thread about migrating console telemetry to the new compact KV+timebucket shape. Need alignment on read adapters and dashboard fallout.

emma: +1. Can we list the invariants we must preserve? (dashboards, quota math, per-route p99)

raj: Invariants: exact per-route monthly counts for billing, per-tenant quota windows, and query latency SLOs. Anything that causes a >1% change in billing numbers is a hard no.

lina: Also keep alerts stable: rule IDs can change but not the effective threshold outputs. Dashboards should show identical series post-migration.

paul: Proposed plan: dual-write into old envelope schema and new compact shape for 2 weeks, run read-adapter to serve dashboards from old schema while we validate. Then cut reads once parity is proven. Thoughts on backfill?

emma: Dual-write sounds safe. Backfill cost is the wildcard. We should snapshot a week's hot-window and run a dry-run compaction to estimate tokens/IO.

raj: For parity checks we need a lightweight diff job that compares aggregates (per-route/day, per-tenant/day) with tolerances. I can sketch the SQL.

simon: Please keep tolerances strict: billing aggregates must be exact; operational metrics can have tiny deltas but we need to quantify them.

paul: SQL sketch for parity check:
```sql
-- compare daily route counts
select route_id, day, old.count as old_count, new.count as new_count, (old.count - new.count) as delta
from old_agg as old
join new_agg as new using(route_id, day)
where old.count != new.count;
```
We should also compare p95/p99 latencies via histogram rollups.

lina: Querying histograms across two shapes is annoying. Suggest we produce identical histogram buckets during dual-write to avoid mismatch. Means instrumenter change.

emma: Agree. We'll change the ingest path to emit compatible buckets for the canary period. That adds an extra field but keeps queries identical.

raj: Routing/quotas: the new shape compacts route tags into KV map. We must ensure quota-routing lookup keys (route_tag normalized) still map 1:1. Any change will break quota enforcement.

simon: Make a gating test that maps 100k route examples and verifies lookup equality. If any mismatch -> block cut.

paul: Rollout UX: Console should expose a toggle to opt a tenant into the new backend for testing. Preferably a per-tenant flag that hits the routing layer to switch read/write.

lina: Can we reuse existing feature-flag service? Should be cheap to add a flag at route-profile level.

emma: Important: when tenant opts-in, dashboards must switch seamlessly with no duplicated time series. We'll use a switch-over marker and a single TTL-based dedupe window.

raj: Edge case: a request that crosses the cutover window might write to both shapes (during partial dual-write). Dedupe must use (request_id) if available, else time+route fuzz. Document this.

simon: Security/compliance: Private deployments might not want dual-write to hosted storage. Ensure the dual-write component is toggleable per-deployment and disabled by default for Private.

paul: Good call. We'll make dual-write controlled by config and default off in private. infra-bot will enforce via a preflight.

infra-bot: preflight check recommended: ensure backfill job has a kill switch, estimate cost, and verify IAM creds for compact-store writes.

lina: Backfill approach: incremental timebucket copy in date windows with idempotent upserts. Add a write-verify step for each chunk.

emma: Monitoring: create canary dashboards comparing old vs new with ratios and alert on >0 divergence for billing aggregates. Also alert on ingestion error spikes.

raj: We'll publish a runbook section for the rollback path: how to flip reads back, drain queues, and re-run parity after rollback. Keep steps reversible and tested in staging.

simon: Action items:
- raj: draft parity SQLs and histogram diff job (ETA 2d)
- lina: instrumenter change to emit compatible buckets + feature flag hook (ETA 3d)
- paul: feature-toggle in console + per-tenant opt-in UX (ETA 4d)
- emma: monitoring & alerts, billing parity alert (ETA 3d)
- infra-bot: preflight checklist template (ETA 1d)

emma: I'll coordinate an on-call blast window for the initial canary. Prefer low-traffic weekend.

paul: One more: update docs for SDKs that read route metrics; call out the migration and expected timelines.

lina: thumbs-up :thumbsup:

simon: Ok letting folks run. Please ping once parity job prototype exists. Thanks all.
